feed.headline: Italy approves elections overhaul as opposition accuse Meloni of 'scam'
feed.ai: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says the move will deliver more stable government, but opposition parties say her aim is to stay in power.
feed.frag: Highlights the limits of national coordination

feed.headline: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election
feed.ai: Calling of a snap election was not a knee-jerk reaction from Pedro Sánchez but a carefully thought-out manoeuvre, Guy Hedgecoe reports from Madrid.

feed.headline: France Is Veering Toward a Potential Debt Crisis, a Warning to the World
feed.ai: French bond investors are demanding sharply higher interest rates, a cautionary development for other high-debt countries.

feed.headline: UK and Germany will face threats together, says Burnham in Berlin
feed.ai: Ahead of a UK-EU summit next month, Burnham said he was committed to "see if we can bring the UK closer to Europe".

feed.headline: 'Come all the way' back to EU, French finance minister tells UK
feed.ai: Roland Lescure tells the BBC that being in the bloc enables members to better address the challenges facing the world.

feed.headline: Italy Weighs Controversial Law Giving Bonus Seats to Election Winners
feed.ai: Supporters of the legislation say it will bring stability to a country with a long history of short-lived governments, but critics see the measure as a threat to democracy.

feed.headline: Protests in Turkey’s Izmir after mayor switches to Erdogan’s AK Party
feed.ai: Protesters gathered in Izmir after Mayor Cemil Tugay joined President Recep Tayyip Erdogan’s AK Party, with demonstrators calling for his resignation.

feed.headline: Europe Today: Rubio urges Europe to wake up as EU trade chief begins key China trip
feed.ai: Europe's ties with China, the US and the UK are all being tested at once. EU trade chief Maroš Šefčovič is in Beijing with a deadline to rebalance trade relations, Marco Rubio tells Europe to wake up, and London weighs rejoining the EU. In France, students are back on the streets today.

feed.headline: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests
feed.ai: Sánchez says Spain will head to the polls on 29 November after recent defeats on measures aimed at addressing the country's housing crisis.

feed.headline: Spain and China are cosying up - to the anger of many in the EU
feed.ai: Amid global tumult, the two countries' alliance is not the only unlikely pairing.

feed.headline: Rubio Stresses Need for U.S. Security Work With Greece on Migration and Terrorism
feed.ai: Secretary of State Marco Rubio praised Greece for spending more on defense, while saying it needs to address “mass migration.”

feed.headline: Amid Midterm Crunch, Trump Advisers Took Time to Help Russia-Aligned Government
feed.ai: James Blair and Chris LaCivita, who are leading the president’s congressional campaign operation, traveled to Republika Srpska to provide election advice.
